title: Personal Checking: which overdraft item fee a bank-error coverage review concerns
content:
## Scope

This rule applies to the bank-error review of an overdraft item fee on a Personal Checking account, the review that asks whether the item should have been paid by an overdraft protection transfer instead of into overdraft. It fixes which fee and which item that review concerns.

## Why the review exists

Under the Personal Checking overdraft fee rules, an overdraft protection transfer is attempted before any item is paid into overdraft, and a covered item is not an overdraft and carries no overdraft-item fee.

## Formal clauses

1. **Which fee.** This review concerns the account's most recently posted overdraft item fee. Any earlier overdraft item fee is reviewed under the general Personal Checking fee refund rules.
2. **Which item.** The item that carried the fee is the entry named as the fee's source item.

## Input, judgement, output

```
All overdraft item fees on the account
  -> the most recently posted one        -> the fee under this review
       its source item                   -> the item that carried the fee
  -> any earlier overdraft item fee      -> reviewed under the general fee refund rules
```

## Worked cases (hypothetical)

- An account shows overdraft item fees posted on 2026-04-02 and 2026-04-19. The fee of 2026-04-19 is the one under this review, and the item it names as its source item is the item that carried it. The fee of 2026-04-02 is reviewed under the general fee refund rules.
- An account shows one overdraft item fee and one returned item fee. Only the overdraft item fee is an overdraft item fee; a returned item fee is not the subject of this review.

## Points of judgement

- **Wrong reading:** "the largest overdraft item fee is the one reviewed". **Correct basis:** the most recently posted one is reviewed.
- **Wrong reading:** "the item is whichever debit posted closest to the fee". **Correct basis:** the item is the entry the fee names as its source item.
